label.aud_lapsed: for customers who stopped ordering (4+ weeks)

label.reward_only: No discount; ₹{reward} Brand Pack reward for regulars

wa.title: TrueLift weekly summary: {name}, week {week}
wa.extra_orders: Extra orders it created: {low} to {high} (best estimate {best})
wa.extra_profit: Extra profit for you: {low} to {high} (best estimate {best})
wa.how: How we know: 1 in {one_in} eligible customers did not see the offer, and we compare the two groups.
wa.verdict_keep: This offer is making you money. Keep it.
wa.verdict_pause: This offer is losing money, so it has been paused.
wa.verdict_probably_losing: This offer is probably losing you money. It keeps running until you stop it.
wa.verdict_wait: Too early to say. Keep it running; the range narrows every week.
wa.verdict_check_failed: The control group did not split as planned this week, so no result is shown; we are checking.
wa.bp_line: Brand Pack reward, measured on its own (1 in {one_in} regulars did not get it): {low} to {high} for you (best estimate {best}). {verdict}
wa.bp_pays: The Brand Pack reward brings in more profit from your regulars than it costs.
wa.bp_costs: The Brand Pack reward costs more than the extra orders it brings from your regulars.
wa.bp_unclear: Not yet clear whether the Brand Pack reward pays for itself.
wa.bp_too_early: Too early to tell whether the Brand Pack reward pays: too few orders from regulars so far.
wa.open: Open the Offers tab in the partner app to keep, change or stop it.

otp.runs_weeks: {weeks} weeks, then needs a new OTP
otp.who_pays: You pay the discount and any Brand Pack rewards. Nothing is deducted without this approval.
otp.who_pays_shared: You pay the discount, except for customers new to Zomato, where Zomato pays {share}%. Brand Pack rewards are paid by you.
otp.weekly: A weekly summary comes on WhatsApp. If the offer is clearly losing money it pauses by itself.
otp.enter: Enter the OTP sent to your registered phone
